what_changed.headline: US hyperscaler funding is reshaping euro credit supply
what_changed.significance: Hyperscalers account for around €40bn outstanding and just under 10% of new euro non-financial corporate issuance; their spreads have widened as investors demand compensation for rising supply and uncertainty.
what_changed.transmission: Greater long-maturity, high-grade tech issuance can absorb portfolio capacity and eventually raise funding costs for other issuers.

what_changed.headline: Inflation resilience is reinforcing a hawkish near-term rates bias
what_changed.significance: German August headline inflation rose to 2.9% y/y, while ING expects euro-area headline inflation to remain above 3% into year-end under its energy-war base case; ECB hiking risk is consequently elevated.
what_changed.transmission: Higher energy inflation and resilient activity increase the likelihood of precautionary tightening, but weaker underlying services inflation limits the case for sustained restriction.

what_changed.headline: US curve pressure is increasingly attributed to real yields and supply
what_changed.significance: ING reports higher US long yields despite easing break-evens and expects the 10-year yield to move toward 4.75–5%; this is an attributed forecast, not an observed outcome.
what_changed.transmission: Higher real yields and issuance pressure can steepen the curve, while limited expected additional Fed tightening constrains follow-through in the dollar.

executive_decisions.development: Monitor euro credit concentration and concession risk in hyperscaler issuance.
executive_decisions.why_it_matters: The first issuance wave has not yet materially crowded out other euro issuers, but investor demand has weakened and hyperscaler risk premia are rising.
executive_decisions.transmission: Further supply could widen spreads for hyperscalers and comparable issuers, especially at the long end.

executive_decisions.development: Treat near-term central-bank risk as asymmetric toward tighter policy, but avoid extrapolating supply inflation into persistent core inflation.
executive_decisions.why_it_matters: German and euro-area headline inflation is rising, while services and core measures remain comparatively contained.
executive_decisions.transmission: Energy-driven inflation supports near-term hikes; lack of second-round effects would limit the subsequent tightening cycle.

macro_themes.theme: AI investment is becoming a cross-market financing and duration shock
macro_themes.thesis: AI capex is broadening from an equity growth story into substantial long-maturity corporate borrowing, with potential implications for credit allocation and real yields.
macro_themes.market_implication: Favourable AI demand does not eliminate financing risk: supply, concentration, leverage and delayed revenue realization can raise credit premia and pressure long-duration assets.

observed_facts.text: Hyperscalers have around €40bn of euro-denominated bonds outstanding and account for just under 10% of new euro non-financial corporate issuance.
Broadcom’s AI semiconductor revenue was reported at USD 10.8bn, up 143% year-on-year, while Marvell’s shares declined after strong results.

inferences.text: If borrowing needs remain elevated, AI may exert upward pressure on long-end real yields and compete with other high-grade bond supply.

conflicting_evidence.text: ECB Blog finds limited spillovers to other euro corporate issuers so far, whereas it warns that future issuance could create broader crowding-out.

unresolved_questions: Will future AI capex be financed primarily through internal cash flow or sustained bond issuance?
Will investment returns and customer diversification validate current growth assumptions?

transmission.implication: Potential widening of hyperscaler and eventually broader long-maturity credit spreads as supply and uncertainty rise.
Upward pressure on long-end real yields if private and sovereign funding compete for duration.
AI infrastructure equities remain sensitive to delivery timelines and elevated expectations.

catalysts: Broadcom earnings and commentary on custom-chip ramps
invalidation_conditions: A sustained shift back toward internally funded AI capex
Evidence that issuance is absorbed without rising risk premia
